ebay-sneakers.description: Calculate eBay sneaker selling fees (8% at $150+ with no per-order fee, 13.6% + $0.40 under $150), shipping costs, and net payout.
ebay-sneakers.feeNote: 8% final value fee when the total sale is $150 or more (no per-order fee); 13.6% + $0.40 per order below $150 ($0.30 if the order is $10 or less).

faqs.q: What is the eBay sneaker fee in 2026?
faqs.a: For qualifying men's and women's athletic shoes, eBay charges 8% of the total sale when it is $150 or more, with no per-order fee. Below $150 the standard 13.6% applies, plus a per-order fee of $0.30 (orders of $10 or less) or $0.40 (orders over $10).

faqs.q: Does eBay charge fees on shipping?
faqs.a: Yes. The final value fee is calculated on the total amount of the sale, which includes the item price, the shipping you charge the buyer, and sales tax collected.

faqs.q: Do eBay Store subscribers pay less on sneakers?
faqs.a: Yes. For qualifying athletic shoes sold at $150 or more, Basic Store and higher subscriptions are reported at 7% instead of 8%. Check eBay's current fee page for exact terms.

ebay-sneakers.extraHtml:
How eBay sneaker fees work in 2026

eBay's sneaker fees depend on one number: the total amount of the sale. That total includes the item price, the shipping you charge the buyer, and any sales tax eBay collects. For qualifying men's and women's athletic shoes, a total of $150 or more is charged 8% with no per-order fee. Below $150, the standard 13.6% rate applies plus a per-order fee of $0.30 (orders of $10 or less) or $0.40 (orders over $10).

Two worked examples

  • Sold for $200 with no shipping charged: the fee is 8% of $200 = $16.00, with no per-order fee. eBay pays out $184.00. If the pair cost you $130, that leaves $54.00 before your own shipping and other costs.
  • Sold for $120 plus $12 shipping charged: the total is $132, so the fee is 13.6% of $132 = $17.95, plus $0.40 per order = $18.35. eBay pays out $113.65. With a $70 cost and a $12 shipping label, you keep $31.65.

Watch the $150 line

A pair that sells for a $149 total pays about $20.66 in fees (13.6% + $0.40). The same pair at a $150 total pays $12.00. Because the lower rate starts at $150, selling at $150 instead of $149 leaves you about $9.66 better off after fees.

Tips to keep more of each sale

  • Check the total, not just the item price. Shipping and sales tax count toward the $150 line.
  • Basic Store and higher subscriptions are reported at 7% on qualifying sneakers at $150 or more, so high-volume sellers may save by subscribing.
  • Enter your shipping label cost and any promoted-listing rate in the calculator to see a true profit figure.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. eBay updates its fees from time to time, so confirm current rates on eBay's official selling fees page before making pricing decisions.

etsy-digital.feeNote: 6.5% transaction fee + 3% payment processing + $0.25 fixed processing fee + $0.20 listing fee (US sellers).

faqs.q: How much does Etsy take from digital downloads?
faqs.a: Etsy deducts a $0.20 listing fee, a 6.5% transaction fee, and a 3% + $0.25 payment processing fee on US orders.

faqs.q: Are digital products exempt from shipping fees on Etsy?
faqs.a: Yes, digital downloads have zero shipping costs, maximizing net profit margins.

faqs.q: Does Etsy charge more if a sale comes from Offsite Ads?
faqs.a: Yes. When a sale comes through an Offsite Ad, Etsy charges an extra 15% of the order total (12% for shops that earned $10,000 or more in the past 12 months). Enter the ad fee percentage in the calculator to include it.

etsy-digital.extraHtml:
How Etsy fees work for digital downloads

Digital products have no shipping cost, but Etsy fees still add up. For US shops, each sale carries a 6.5% transaction fee on the order total, a 3% + $0.25 payment processing fee, and a $0.20 listing fee that is charged when a listing is published and again each time it renews or sells.

Worked example: a $10 download

  • Transaction fee: 6.5% of $10 = $0.65
  • Payment processing: 3% of $10 + $0.25 = $0.55
  • Listing fee: $0.20
  • Total fees: $1.40, so you keep $8.60 before taxes and your own costs.

If the sale comes through an Offsite Ad, Etsy adds a 15% fee (12% for shops with $10,000 or more in sales over the past 12 months). On the same $10 sale at 15%, that is another $1.50, bringing total fees to $2.90 and your payout to $7.10. Enter the ad fee percentage in the calculator to see the effect on your margin.

Why low prices hurt

The $0.25 payment fee and the $0.20 listing fee are fixed, so they take a bigger bite from cheaper products. On a $3 download they total $0.45 before any percentage fees, which is 15% of the sale. Bundling several designs into one higher-priced listing usually protects your margin better than selling them one by one.

Rates shown are US figures last reviewed in November 2026. Confirm current fees in Etsy's Seller Handbook before pricing.

faqs.q: How much commission does Poshmark take?
faqs.a: Poshmark takes a flat $2.95 on sales under $15, and 20% on sales of $15 or more.

faqs.q: Who pays for shipping on Poshmark?
faqs.a: The buyer pays standard shipping unless the seller offers a shipping discount.

faqs.q: Does Poshmark charge a fee on shipping?
faqs.a: No. The commission is calculated on the item price. Shipping is paid separately by the buyer and is not part of the seller's commission.

poshmark.extraHtml:
How Poshmark seller fees work in 2026

Poshmark uses one selling fee with two tiers. Sales under $15 pay a flat $2.95. Sales of $15 or more pay a 20% commission. The fee already covers payment processing, and there are no listing fees. The commission is based on the item price, not on shipping, which the buyer pays separately.

Worked examples

  • $75 jacket: 20% = $15.00, so you receive $60.00 before your item cost.
  • $12 necklace: flat $2.95, so you receive $9.05. That is about 24.6% of the sale.

The $15 line

A $14.99 item pays $2.95 and leaves you $12.04. A $15.00 item pays $3.00 and leaves you $12.00. Right at the line, the higher price leaves you slightly less, and it only pulls ahead once the price is above about $15.05.

Bundle small items

Three $8 items sold separately pay $2.95 each, or $8.85 in fees on $24 of sales. Bundled into a single $24 sale, the fee is 20% = $4.80. You keep $19.20 instead of $15.15, which is $4.05 more.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Poshmark can change its fees, so confirm current rates in Poshmark's help center before pricing.

ebay-electronics.description: Calculate eBay final value fees for phones, laptops, and electronics (13.6% + $0.30 to $0.40 per order) and net profit.
ebay-electronics.feeNote: Standard 13.6% final value fee for consumer electronics (2.35% on the portion above $7,500) + $0.40 per order over $10 ($0.30 if $10 or less).

faqs.q: What is the eBay selling fee for electronics?
faqs.a: eBay charges 13.6% on the total sale amount for most consumer electronics, plus a per-order fee of $0.30 (orders of $10 or less) or $0.40 (orders over $10).

faqs.q: Is there a lower fee tier for high-value electronics on eBay?
faqs.a: Yes, the portion of a sale above $7,500 is charged at a reduced 2.35% rate.

ebay-clothing.description: Calculate eBay 13.6% + $0.30 to $0.40 selling fees, shipping deductions, and profit margin for apparel resellers.
ebay-clothing.feeNote: 13.6% final value fee on the total sale + $0.40 per order over $10 ($0.30 if $10 or less).

faqs.q: What is the eBay fee for selling clothes?
faqs.a: Most clothing and apparel items are charged 13.6% of the total sale amount plus a per-order fee of $0.30 (orders of $10 or less) or $0.40 (orders over $10).

faqs.q: Do eBay Store subscribers get lower clothing fees?
faqs.a: Yes, Basic Store subscribers and above receive discounted final value fees in many categories.

ebay-auto-parts.description: Calculate eBay Motors parts and accessories selling fees (13.6% + $0.30 to $0.40), heavy shipping costs, and net profit per auto part.
ebay-auto-parts.feeNote: 13.6% final value fee on parts and accessories up to $7,500 + $0.40 per order over $10 ($0.30 if $10 or less).

faqs.q: How much does eBay charge for auto parts?
faqs.a: eBay charges 13.6% on most parts and accessories up to $7,500, plus a per-order fee of $0.30 (orders of $10 or less) or $0.40 (orders over $10).

faqs.q: Does eBay charge fees on collected sales tax?
faqs.a: Yes, the 13.6% percentage applies to the item price, shipping, and buyer sales tax combined.

etsy-pod.feeNote: 6.5% transaction fee + 3% payment processing + $0.25 fixed processing fee + $0.20 listing fee (US sellers).

etsy-handmade.feeNote: 6.5% transaction fee + 3% payment processing + $0.25 fixed processing fee + $0.20 listing fee (US sellers).

etsy-vintage.feeNote: 6.5% transaction fee + 3% payment processing + $0.25 fixed processing fee + $0.20 listing fee (US sellers).

etsy-offsite-ads.feeNote: 15% Offsite Ads fee (12% for shops with $10,000+ in sales over the past 12 months) + 6.5% transaction fee + 3% processing + $0.45 fixed fees (US sellers).

faqs.q: How much is the Mercari selling fee?
faqs.a: Mercari charges a flat 10% selling fee on the total completed sale price.

faqs.q: Does Mercari charge a listing fee?
faqs.a: No, listing items on Mercari is completely free.

faqs.q: Does Mercari's 10% fee apply to shipping?
faqs.a: Yes. The 10% selling fee is calculated on the item price plus any shipping the buyer pays.

faqs.q: Does Mercari charge a payment processing fee?
faqs.a: Not on listings created or updated since January 6, 2025. The old separate processing fee was removed, so the 10% selling fee is the only seller fee on most sales. Buyers pay their own Buyer Protection fee, which does not reduce your payout.

mercari.extraHtml:
How Mercari seller fees work in 2026

Mercari charges sellers one fee: 10% of the item price plus any shipping the buyer pays. Listing is free, and since January 6, 2025 there is no separate payment processing fee on listings created or updated after that date. Buyers pay their own Buyer Protection fee at checkout, which does not come out of your payout.

Worked examples

  • $50 item with $8 shipping paid by the buyer: the fee is 10% of $58 = $5.80, so you receive $52.20 before paying for the shipping label.
  • $20 item with no shipping charged: the fee is $2.00 and you receive $18.00.

Pricing to hit a target

If you want to keep $40 and the buyer pays no shipping, divide by 0.90 and list at about $44.45.

Things to know

  • The fee includes buyer-paid shipping, so charging shipping separately does not avoid it.
  • Standard bank payouts are free. Instant Pay carries its own fee, reported at $3 per cash-out.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Fees change from time to time, so confirm current rates on the platform's official fee page before pricing.

upwork.description: Calculate your net Upwork earnings after the freelancer service fee (typically around 10%, variable 0-15% per contract) and work out the rate to quote.
upwork.feeNote: Typical rate shown: 10%. Since May 1, 2025, new contracts carry a variable freelancer fee of 0-15%, shown before you accept; contracts started earlier stay at a flat 10%.

faqs.q: What is Upwork's freelancer service fee?
faqs.a: Since May 1, 2025, new contracts carry a variable freelancer fee between 0% and 15%. The rate is shown when you submit a proposal or receive an offer and stays fixed for that contract. Many freelancers report about 10% on typical contracts, and contracts started before May 2025 keep a flat 10%.

faqs.q: How do I calculate what to charge to get a specific net amount?
faqs.a: Divide your desired take-home pay by 1 minus your fee rate. At a 10% fee, divide by 0.90. At 15%, divide by 0.85.

faqs.q: How do I test a different Upwork fee in this calculator?
faqs.a: The calculator starts from a 10% fee. To test 15%, enter 5 in the Ad / Promo box, which adds 5 percentage points.

upwork.extraHtml:
How Upwork's freelancer fee works in 2026

Since May 1, 2025, Upwork has charged freelancers a variable service fee of 0% to 15% on new contracts, instead of the flat 10% it used before. The rate is shown when you submit a proposal or receive an offer and stays fixed for that contract. Contracts that started before May 2025 remain on the flat 10%. This calculator starts from 10% as a typical rate, so adjust it to the rate on your own contract.

Worked examples

  • A $1,000 project at a 10% fee leaves you $900. At 15% it leaves $850.
  • To take home $50 an hour, quote about $55.56 at a 10% fee, or about $58.82 at 15%.

Costs outside the service fee

  • Connects used to send proposals are a separate cost, reported at $0.15 each.
  • Withdrawal and currency conversion fees can apply when you move money out of Upwork.
  • Clients pay their own fees separately, so they do not reduce your payout.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Upwork shows the exact rate for each contract, so always check it before you accept.

fiverr.extraHtml:
How Fiverr's 20% commission works

Fiverr keeps a flat 20% of every order. That includes the base gig price, gig extras, custom offers, and tips, and it does not drop as you earn more or level up. Buyers pay a separate service fee on top of your price, which does not reduce your payout.

Worked examples

  • $100 gig: Fiverr keeps $20 and you receive $80.
  • $150 gig plus a $30 rush delivery extra plus a $20 tip = $200: Fiverr keeps $40 and you receive $160.

Pricing to hit a target

To keep $100, price the gig at $125 (divide by 0.80). To keep $400, price it at $500.

Tips are not exempt

Because the 20% also applies to tips, a $20 tip arrives as $16. Do not count on tips to make up for an underpriced gig.

Withdrawal fees vary by method and are not included. Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Fees change from time to time, so confirm current rates on the platform's official fee page before pricing.

faqs.q: What is the Stripe and Shopify Basic transaction fee?
faqs.a: Both Shopify Basic (using Shopify Payments) and Stripe charge 2.9% + $0.30 per online card transaction.

faqs.q: Are transaction fees refunded when issuing a customer refund?
faqs.a: No, Stripe and Shopify Payments do not return the original processing fees on refunded orders.

faqs.q: Does Shopify charge extra if I use Stripe instead of Shopify Payments?
faqs.a: Yes. On Shopify plans, using an outside payment provider adds a third-party gateway fee on top of the provider's own rate. On the Basic plan it is 2%. Using Shopify Payments avoids it.

shopify-stripe.extraHtml:
How Shopify and Stripe card fees work

On Shopify's Basic plan with Shopify Payments, and on Stripe directly, US online card sales cost 2.9% plus $0.30. This calculator covers that card fee only. Your monthly Shopify plan, apps, shipping, and product costs are separate.

Worked examples

  • $60 order: 2.9% = $1.74, plus $0.30 = $2.04 in fees, so you keep $57.96.
  • $10 order: $0.29 plus $0.30 = $0.59, which is 5.9% of the sale. The fixed $0.30 hurts small orders the most.

Fees this calculator does not include

  • If you run Stripe or another outside gateway on a Shopify plan instead of Shopify Payments, Shopify adds a 2% third-party gateway fee on Basic. A $60 order would then cost about 4.9% + $0.30 = $3.24.
  • Shopify lists higher rates for premium cards (3.5% + 30 cents) and an extra 1% for international cards.
  • Higher Shopify plans lower the card rate: 2.7% on Grow and 2.5% on Advanced in the US.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Fees change from time to time, so confirm current rates on the platform's official fee page before pricing.

depop.description: Calculate Depop payment processing fees for US sellers (3.3% + $0.45), optional Boosted Listing fees, and net profit per item.
depop.feeNote: No selling fee for US sellers; 3.3% + $0.45 payment processing on item + shipping + tax. UK sellers pay 2.9% + £0.30, so treat UK results as estimates.

faqs.q: Does Depop still charge a 10% selling fee?
faqs.a: Not for sellers based in the US, UK, or Australia. US sellers pay payment processing of 3.3% + $0.45 per transaction, and UK sellers pay 2.9% + £0.30. The 10% selling fee still applies to sellers in other countries.

faqs.q: How much do Depop Boosted Listings cost?
faqs.a: Depop lists a 12% fee for US and UK sellers, charged only when the item sells through boosting. Older guides show 8%, so check the rate in your Depop app before boosting.

faqs.q: What does Depop's processing fee apply to?
faqs.a: It applies to the item price, the shipping charged to the buyer, and any sales tax.

depop.extraHtml:
How Depop fees work in 2026

Depop charges sellers in the US, UK, and Australia no selling fee. What you pay is payment processing: 3.3% + $0.45 per transaction for US sellers (2.9% + £0.30 in the UK), charged on the item price plus shipping and any sales tax. Sellers elsewhere still pay a 10% selling fee. Buyers pay their own marketplace fee on top, which does not come out of your payout.

Worked examples

  • $90 item with $10 shipping charged: the total is $100, so processing is 3.3% of $100 + $0.45 = $3.75. You receive $96.25 before your shipping label.
  • $10 item with no shipping: $0.33 + $0.45 = $0.78, which is 7.8% of the sale. The fixed $0.45 weighs most on cheap items.

Boosting changes the math

Boosted Listings add a fee only when the item sells through boosting. Depop lists 12% for US and UK sellers. A $50 item sold through a boost with no shipping charged pays $6.00 for the boost plus $2.10 in processing, so you receive $41.90.

Selling two items in one order pays the $0.45 fixed fee only once.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Fees change from time to time, so confirm current rates on the platform's official fee page before pricing.

amazon-fba.description: Estimate Amazon 15% referral fees, FBA fulfillment costs (about $3.33 including the 2026 fuel surcharge), COGS, and net ROI per unit.
amazon-fba.feeNote: 15% referral fee + about $3.33 estimated small standard FBA fulfillment fee (includes the 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge since April 17, 2026). Actual fees depend on size, weight, and price band.

faqs.q: What is the average Amazon FBA fee percentage?
faqs.a: Most categories carry a 15% referral fee plus a per-unit FBA fulfillment fee that starts around $3.06 for the lightest small standard items in 2026. A 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge has been added to fulfillment fees since April 17, 2026.

faqs.q: What is a good profit margin for Amazon FBA?
faqs.a: Most FBA sellers target a minimum 25% to 30% net profit margin after product cost, shipping, and PPC ads.

faqs.q: Are FBA fees higher during the holiday season?
faqs.a: Yes. Amazon's holiday peak fulfillment fees apply from October 15, 2026 through January 14, 2027 and average about $0.32 more per unit than non-peak rates.

amazon-fba.extraHtml:
How Amazon FBA fees work in 2026

Two charges hit almost every FBA sale: a referral fee, usually 15% of the sale price, and a per-unit fulfillment fee based on the item's size, weight, and (since January 15, 2026) its price band. Since April 17, 2026, a 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge is added to the fulfillment fee. Your selling plan (Professional is $39.99 a month), storage, and ads are separate. This calculator uses an estimated $3.33 fulfillment fee, so use Amazon's own revenue calculator when you have exact dimensions.

Worked examples

  • $25 item, small standard, 6 oz: referral fee $3.75 + fulfillment $3.45 + surcharge about $0.12 = about $7.32 in fees. That leaves about $17.68 before product cost.
  • $9.99 item: referral fee $1.50 + fulfillment $3.38 + surcharge $0.12 = $5.00, or about half the price.

Why cheap products struggle

Fulfillment fees are fixed per unit, so a low price leaves little room. Check that fees, product cost, and ads still leave a healthy margin before you order inventory.

Peak season

Holiday peak fulfillment fees apply from October 15, 2026 through January 14, 2027 and average about $0.32 more per unit. This estimate does not include them.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Amazon updates fees often, so confirm current rates in Seller Central before pricing.

tiktok-shop.feeNote: Published US referral fee: 6% on most categories (includes payment processing). Some seller resources report 8% since August 4, 2026, so check your Seller Center.

faqs.q: How much does TikTok Shop charge sellers in 2026?
faqs.a: TikTok Shop's published US referral fee is 6% for most categories, with 5% for some such as select jewelry, and it includes payment processing. Some seller resources report an increase to 8% from August 4, 2026, so check the rate shown in your Seller Center before pricing.

faqs.q: How do I include TikTok affiliate commissions?
faqs.a: Enter your creator affiliate percentage in the Ad / Promo (%) box to see exact net profit.

faqs.q: Is there a discount for new TikTok Shop sellers?
faqs.a: TikTok has offered new US sellers a reduced 3% referral rate for 30 days after a first sale made within 60 days of onboarding. Check Seller Center for current terms.

tiktok-shop.extraHtml:
How TikTok Shop seller fees work in 2026

TikTok Shop charges US sellers a referral fee on each order. The published rate is 6% for most categories, with 5% for some, and it already includes payment processing. There are no listing fees or monthly subscription. Some seller resources report that the standard rate rose to 8% on August 4, 2026, which public documentation had not caught up with, so confirm the rate in your Seller Center. This calculator uses 6%.

Illustrative example

A $40 item at 6% pays $2.40 to TikTok. If you also pay a 15% creator commission ($6.00), your costs before product and shipping are $8.40 and you keep $31.60. At an 8% referral fee, TikTok's share would be $3.20 instead.

Other costs to plan for

  • Shipping, fulfillment, and creator commissions are separate from the referral fee.
  • When a buyer returns an item, TikTok refunds the referral fee but keeps a refund administration fee of 20% of it, capped at $5 per SKU.
  • New US sellers have been offered a reduced 3% referral rate for 30 days after a first sale within 60 days of onboarding.

Fee rates last reviewed in November 2026. Fees change from time to time, so confirm current rates on the platform's official fee page before pricing.
